tool.name: team-send-message
tool.description:
Sends an asynchronous (fire-and-forget) message to a team member's inbox topic. Resolves the caller's team from the session, then delivers the body to the inbox of the member named by `to`.
**Parameters**: - `to`: target member name (required). The member must exist in the caller's team and have a bound session. - `body`: message body (required unless `input` is used). - `input`: message body alias for `body` (used when the arguments arrive as free text).
**Semantics**: - The caller's team is resolved via session reverse-lookup (no teamId parameter — an LLM can only message its own team). - ACL: `send` action requires WRITE (LEAD/MEMBER allowed, non-members denied). - Returns a delivery confirmation noting the target topic and correlationId. - Honest fail-loud: if team functionality is not enabled (NoOp team manager) the tool reports the operation was NOT performed — it never pretends success. A missing member / unbound session returns an explicit error.
